trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted objects you currently own, including those inherited from a shared Owner scope. Nothing here is permanently erased.
trash.emptyTypeTitle: No recoverable objects of this type
trash.emptyDescription: Objects appear here only when your current access allows recovery. Removed context links are listed separately inside each Event.
trash.emptyTypeDescription: Try all types. Only objects you can currently recover are shown.
trash.recovered: Recovered as version {version}. Normal views have been refreshed.
trash.keepsNote: Recovery keeps this object's ID, current content, files, permissions, and history. It creates a new version, without replaying an earlier snapshot.
trash.linksNote: Existing links appear again only when both objects are available and authorized. Independently removed links stay removed. Related objects are not recovered automatically.
trash.grantsNote: Recovery does not re-create revoked grants. Inherited access must be managed on its canonical scope.

lifecycle.intro: Removing a context link and moving the object to Trash have different effects.
lifecycle.reloadNote: Close this dialog and reload the view before trying again.
lifecycle.trashTitle: Move the canonical object to Trash
lifecycle.removeNote: The object, its history, permissions, and other contexts remain unchanged. Recover this link from Removed links while both objects are available.
lifecycle.trashNote: This object disappears from normal views and downloads. Its content, files, history, and permissions are retained. Related objects are not deleted. A current Owner can recover it from Trash.
lifecycle.linkRemoved: Link removed. The canonical object remains available.
lifecycle.movedToTrash: Moved to Trash. No related objects were deleted.
lifecycle.noActions: No deletion actions are available with your current access.

removedLinks.title: Removed links
removedLinks.intro: Restore a context link without copying or changing either object. Only links with live, accessible endpoints and an editable source appear here.
removedLinks.emptyDescription: Recover deleted objects from Trash first. An equivalent active link cannot be recovered twice.
removedLinks.recovered: Link recovered. Neither canonical object was changed.
removedLinks.recoveringVersion: Recovering link version {version}. Content and permissions stay unchanged.
removedLinks.refreshNote: Close this preview and refresh the Event before trying again.
